# dsh-quote-annotation
Quote a passage from a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversation, attach an optional note, and send it wit
h your next message as **structured reference context**. The quote never enters your draft and never
shows up as raw JSON in Chat.
中文 · Changelog · Maintainer notes
## Demo
Select → **Add to chat** → optional note → send with the composer still empty. The reply keeps a `No
te N` marker: hover to preview the quote, click to jump back to the source. The Chinese demo is here
; step-by-step stills live in docs/media.
## Features
- **Select → Add to chat.** A small action bar appears over the selection; the quote is stored immed

iately.
- **Optional annotation.** Add or edit a note at any time; `Enter` confirms, `Shift+Enter` i

nserts a newline.
- **Visible record.** A pill in the composer tool row shows what is pending; after

sending, a pill above your message keeps it.
- **Quote-only messages.** The send button enables eve

n when the composer is empty.
- **Inline markers.** Once the turn completes, an `注释 N` marker appear
s in the assistant reply at the paragraph that mentions the quote. Hover to preview, click to jump b

ack to the source.
- **Survives restarts.** Sent records are rebuilt from the Session log, so pills

and markers come back after a Host restart.
- **No editor mutation.** No Lexical chips, no hidden te

xt, no zero-width characters left in the model prompt.
- **Zero dependencies, no build step.** A pla

in ESM host plugin and a single browser module.
- **Speaks your UI language.** Copy follows the DSH
UI locale: Chinese and English ship with the plugin, and every other language falls back to English.
Switching the language in Settings updates the pills, cards, markers and composer live, without a r
hing the language in Settings updates the pills, cards, markers and composer live, without a reload.
> UI copy is Chinese for a Chinese DSH UI (`添加到对话`, `N 条注释`, `注释 N`) and English otherwise (`Add to
chat`, `N quotes`, `Note N`).
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- The Host appends a hidden `user/message` after the direct user message. Chat hides ordinary contex

t nodes, so the raw reference block never renders in the conversation.
- `source.references` carries

the quote, the optional annotation, and source metadata (`nodeKey`, `anchorKey`, turn, kind).
- `GE
T /dsh-quote-annotation/sent` backfills sent records from the Session log, so historical quotes get

pills after a Host restart.
- Quote-only sends use an invisible draft token (`U+2063`) to keep the n

ative send button enabled. The Host strips it before the model step and falls back to `（引用）`.
- Sent
pills sit above `[data-chat-flow-kind="user"][data-chat-turn=…]`; the React tree is never overridde

n.
- Inline markers are appended to the paragraph containing the quote (fallback: the last paragraph
) and are idempotent per `turn:index`.
## Requirements

- DSH `0.2.x` with the Web client modules (DSH Desktop or `dsh web`), including
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-cl

ient-locale` for the language switch.
- A profile you can modify (`web`, `desktop`, …).
- Node.js `>
=22.19.0` for the Host.

## Verify

1. Select text in Chat → **添加到对话**.
2. Optionally annotate; press `Enter`.
3. The composer tool row

shows `N 条注释` and the send button is enabled.
4. Send without typing anything else.
5. A `N 条注释` pil

l appears above the user message; click it to jump to the source.
6. After the reply completes, `注释

N` appears in the assistant text; hover to preview.
7. Chat must not render `## Quoted conversation

n the assistant text; hover to preview.
7. Chat must not render `## Quoted conversation references`.
To disable the plugin without uninstalling, set `disabled: true` on the `quote-annotation` entry in
the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
## Configuration
Defaults live in `cordis.patch.yml` and can be overridden in the profile patch under the `quote-anno
in `cordis.patch.yml` and can be overridden in the profile patch under the `quote-annotation` entry:
| Option | Default | Meaning |

| `maxQuotes` | `8` | Pending quotes kept per session |
| `quoteMaxChars` | `8000` | Max characters

per quoted passage |
| `annotationMaxChars` | `4000` | Max characters per annotation |
| `pendingTtl
Ms` | `86400000` | How long a pending quote stays alive |
## Compatibility
Tested with DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` (Web).
Client-side selectors:

- `[data-conversation-scroll]`
- `[data-chat-flow-kind="user"]`
- `[data-chat-turn]`
- `[data-chat-n
ode-key]` / `[data-chat-anchor-key]`
Host-side contracts:

- `agent/pre-step` waterfall
- `ctx.sessions.get(id).snapshotEvents()` for historical backfill
It deliberately does **not** depend on `conversation.draftContexts`, native Lexical chips, or the re
oes **not** depend on `conversation.draftContexts`, native Lexical chips, or the reference pipeline.
## Limitations
- Pending quotes live in Host memory; a Host restart clears them. Sent records are backfilled from t

he log.
- Sent-pill placement and inline markers are DOM enhancements: a DSH Chat DOM change may req

uire selector updates.
- Inline marker placement is a paragraph heuristic. If the assistant paraphra

ses instead of quoting, the marker lands at the end of the reply.
- There is no native Lexical chip

— that is the price of never mutating the editor.
- UI copy covers Chinese and English only; other l

ocales fall back to English. Host-side
copy follows the language of the last mutation, so a stale ta
b can briefly disagree.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
There is no install step: the plugin has no runtime or dev dependencies.
See AGENTS.md for the runtime model and the invariants to keep.
